observations: Photo 0 shows a dirty engine block with visible oil residue, a throttle body, and part of the intake manifold. The front of the engine has a pulley system and a serpentine belt tensioner.
Photo 1 shows the front of the engine with a large circular crankshaft pulley, a smaller water pump pulley, and a timing cover with a faded or worn label. The engine is coated in grime and oil.
Photo 2 is a similar front view to photo 1, showing the same components, with a black oil pan at the bottom. The label on the timing cover is still unreadable due to wear and dirt.
